# Platform Requirements Checklist: Osteo Vision Software Platform Target

**Purpose**: Validate whether the platform target requirements are complete, clear, measurable, medically conservative, and ready for implementation review.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Last Updated**: 2026-07-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist was originally generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. The 2026-07-04 update records the current implementation review status, using the current worktree, smoke outputs, README updates, and [Export Schema V1](../../../docs/export_schema_v1.md) as evidence.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the three competition value areas mapped to explicit platform capabilities and user stories? [Completeness, Spec §Project Scope Alignment, Spec §User Scenarios]
  - Evidence: spec maps pseudo-color fluorescence enhancement, AI-assisted review, and standardized output/collaboration; README now lists the runnable loop.
- [x] CHK002 Are the boundaries between fluorescence analysis, AI review, and result export fully described without requiring device acquisition layers? [Completeness, Spec §Project Scope Alignment, Constitution §I]
  - Evidence: spec and AGENTS exclude device SDK/acquisition; platform focuses on software-side analysis, review, and export.
- [x] CHK003 Are offline images, synchronized frame sequences, and short videos each covered by input requirements or explicitly deferred? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Input/Output Contract]
  - Evidence: task config accepts 2D images, video files, video streams, NPZ ROI, DICOM series, and NIfTI volumes; current smoke covers JPEG and MP4.
- [ ] CHK004 Are acquisition metadata requirements defined with enough detail to support future timing, exposure, and alignment review? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
  - Remaining gap: optional metadata exists, but timing/exposure/device calibration fields and validation rules are not yet specified in detail.
- [x] CHK005 Are the minimum required evidence artifacts for each case defined beyond broad names such as visuals, summaries, and report material? [Completeness, Spec §Evidence Artifacts, Spec §FR-006]
  - Evidence: `docs/export_schema_v1.md` defines report JSON, Markdown, CSV, DICOM Secondary Capture, bundle manifest, evidence bundle, overlay, heatmap, normalized fluorescence, colorbar, ROI mask, and keyframe artifacts.
- [x] CHK006 Are candidate region, ROI, review state, quality flag, and analysis run entities each tied to at least one functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Functional Requirements]
  - Evidence: `backend/src/domains/cases/schemas.py` implements those entities and export/report snapshots include them.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "suspicious region" defined in non-diagnostic terms that fit ICG perfusion and tissue-viability evidence? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Constitution §II]
  - Evidence: project rules and reports use candidate/risk/hotspot/review-required language and avoid automatic diagnosis.
- [ ] CHK008 Are "low-confidence", "low usability", and "unusable" inputs differentiated with objective criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - Remaining gap: upload validation and several warning codes exist, but a complete medically sensitive warning taxonomy is still missing.
- [ ] CHK009 Is "approved analysis method" defined with governance criteria for what makes a method approved? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
  - Remaining gap: model specs and adapter status exist, but approval criteria, promotion gates, and reviewer sign-off are not formalized for this platform feature.
- [ ] CHK010 Are "candidate regions or risk regions" distinguished from reviewer-defined ROIs with clear ownership and lifecycle rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
  - Remaining gap: code separates candidates and ROIs, but lifecycle rules for accept-modify-reject-restore and threshold changes need a written state-machine rule.
- [x] CHK011 Is "complete evidence bundle" defined as a concrete artifact list with required and optional members? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Spec §FR-006]
  - Evidence: `docs/export_schema_v1.md` defines the current required core files and included artifact entries.
- [ ] CHK012 Are terms such as "quickly enough" and "interactive" quantified or scoped for demo conditions? [Ambiguity, Plan §Performance Goals]
  - Remaining gap: smoke scripts record timings, but no acceptance thresholds are written yet.

## Medical Safety And Review Boundary

- [x] CHK013 Are all user-facing and report-facing outputs required to include platform safety-boundary disclaimers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §II]
  - Evidence: backend disclaimers are included in case creation, reports, Markdown output, DICOM Secondary Capture, and schema docs.
- [x] CHK014 Are prohibited claims specified clearly enough to prevent automatic diagnosis, definitive surgical instruction, and unsupported clinical performance wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-005]
  - Evidence: AGENTS and spec require research/competition wording and prohibit automatic diagnosis claims.
- [ ] CHK015 Are physician review states required for every AI-generated candidate region before final export? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §II]
  - Remaining gap: export includes review state, but the backend does not yet block export when candidates are still `review_required`.
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for cases where the reviewer disagrees with all AI candidates or creates an ROI manually? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - Evidence: ROI creation/update and manual region source are represented in schemas and frontend review flow.
- [x] CHK017 Are ICG signal limitations documented as requirements for wording, labels, reports, and presentation copy? [Gap, Constitution §II, Plan §Medical Safety Boundary]
  - Evidence: AGENTS, reports, DICOM SC rendering, and export schema document the ICG limitation.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are primary import, review, ROI refinement, and export scenarios independently measurable from the written acceptance scenarios? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
  - Evidence: platform smoke and frontend E2E cover create/import/analyze/review/export flows.
- [x] CHK019 Are alternate flows defined for single-frame versus short-sequence cases? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
  - Evidence: current smoke covers JPEG pair analysis and MP4 keyframe analysis.
- [ ] CHK020 Are exception flows defined for mismatched size, timing, content, overexposure, weak signal, blur, and occlusion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - Remaining gap: some validation and warnings exist, but timing/content mismatch, blur, occlusion, abnormal codec, and rotation metadata are not fully specified or tested.
- [ ] CHK021 Are recovery requirements defined for interrupted export, partial artifact generation, and retry behavior? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - Remaining gap: export bundle generation is tested, but interrupted export recovery is not specified.
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a case with no candidate region while still needing a report? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
  - Remaining gap: this needs a dedicated backend/frontend test and documented expected report behavior.
- [ ] CHK023 Are conflicting reviewer action rules specified for accept-then-modify, reject-then-restore, and threshold changes after acceptance? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §US2]
  - Remaining gap: review events exist, but conflict resolution rules are not fully written.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK024 Can SC-001 be objectively evaluated with a defined required artifact list and representative case criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
  - Evidence: export schema and platform smoke define and verify the representative evidence bundle artifacts.
- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated with thresholds or classification rules for weak-signal, mismatched, overexposed, and blurred cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
  - Remaining gap: weak-signal and mismatch handling exists in parts, but full thresholds and acceptance rules are incomplete.
- [x] CHK026 Does SC-003 specify which review state fields must be reflected in exported reports? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003]
  - Evidence: JSON report includes `review_summary`, `rois`, `review_events`, and candidate region status.
- [x] CHK027 Does SC-004 define the minimum structure for fused visual evidence, quantitative summary, review record, and disclaimer? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
  - Evidence: export schema and report builders define fused artifacts, quantification CSV/JSON, review state, and disclaimers.
- [ ] CHK028 Does SC-005 define a reviewable vocabulary or safety-wording rule for detecting unsupported diagnosis language? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
  - Remaining gap: project rules prohibit unsafe wording, but there is no automated wording lint/checklist yet.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are local deployment assumptions, supported operating systems, and browser expectations specified for the V1 workstation workflow? [Completeness, Plan §Target Platform]
  - Evidence: plan states browser-based local workstation deployment; README and quickstart document backend and frontend ports.
- [ ] CHK030 Are performance targets expressed as measurable limits for representative case loading, ROI interaction, and export? [Gap, Plan §Performance Goals]
  - Remaining gap: smoke timing exists, but formal limits are not set.
- [x] CHK031 Are privacy, de-identification, and minimum-retention requirements explicitly tied to case inputs, metadata, exports, and logs? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Tasks §Clarification Assumption]
  - Evidence: AGENTS excludes raw medical data/checkpoints from Git; DICOM SC marks identity removed; export schema keeps platform safety/de-identification boundaries.
- [ ] CHK032 Are accessibility and basic usability requirements defined for reviewer-facing image inspection and ROI controls? [Gap, Spec §User Scenarios]
  - Remaining gap: frontend tests cover framing and mobile viewport, but accessibility and detailed ROI usability requirements are not written.
- [x] CHK033 Are auditability requirements defined for review history, provenance, analysis run parameters, and export timestamps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Key Entities]
  - Evidence: schemas include review events, analysis run parameters, timestamps, artifact checksums, and export manifests.
- [ ] CHK034 Are failure messages and warning severity levels specified for medically sensitive low-confidence cases? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-007]
  - Remaining gap: upload failure messages improved for 415/422, but a complete severity taxonomy is still needed.

## Architecture And Replaceability

- [x] CHK035 Are frontend, backend, analysis core, and export responsibilities separated in requirements without over-constraining implementation details? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Constitution §III]
  - Evidence: `frontend/`, `backend/`, `src/`, and report/export layers are separated.
- [x] CHK036 Are model and dataset replaceability requirements stated at the workflow contract level rather than tied to specific model families? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §III]
  - Evidence: model specs, adapters, task configs, and manifests keep model families replaceable.
- [x] CHK037 Are configuration, adapter, pipeline, manifest, and report-writer boundaries reflected in the feature requirements or plan? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §III]
  - Evidence: configs, adapters, pipelines, manifests, smoke tools, and report writers are present and tested.
- [x] CHK038 Are temporary Gradio demo constraints clearly separated from the long-term Vue/FastAPI platform target? [Clarity, Plan §Summary, Plan §Constraints]
  - Evidence: README and quickstart mark Gradio as legacy/temporary; V1 platform uses Vue and FastAPI.

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [x] CHK039 Is the local single-user V1 assumption documented consistently across spec, plan, tasks, and quickstart? [Assumption, Tasks §Clarification Assumption, Plan §Scale/Scope]
  - Evidence: plan and quickstart describe local workstation deployment and small-team/single-case demo scope.
- [x] CHK040 Are out-of-scope dependencies such as device SDKs, HIS/EMR/PACS, full patient management, and automatic diagnosis consistently excluded? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, Plan §Constraints, Constitution §I]
  - Evidence: spec, plan, and AGENTS exclude these dependencies.
- [x] CHK041 Are external data requirements and sample provenance expectations specified before any clinical or performance claims are allowed? [Dependency, Constitution §V, Spec §Medical Safety Boundary]
  - Evidence: AGENTS requires provenance, manifest tracking, non-target-domain labels, and no clinical performance claims without target-domain evidence.
- [x] CHK042 Are artifact retention and Git exclusion rules reflected in requirements for evidence bundles and generated outputs? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Tasks §Polish]
  - Evidence: AGENTS, `.gitignore`, readiness checks, and export schema separate evidence artifacts from Git-tracked source.

## Open Follow-Up Items

- Define objective warning taxonomy for low-confidence, low-usability, unusable, weak signal, blur, occlusion, timing mismatch, codec failure, and rotation metadata.
- Add export blocking or review-state policy for unresolved `review_required` candidates if the competition report requires strict physician sign-off.
- Add performance targets for representative 4K JPEG/MP4 upload, keyframe extraction, ROI interaction, export, and 1-10 minute proxy videos.
- Write DICOM SR/SEG roadmap and validator plan; current output remains DICOM Secondary Capture only.
- Add automated wording checks for unsupported diagnosis and clinical-performance claims.

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
